notes.title: The 9th Charnel to be featured at The Horror Game Awards 2024
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42507825/370378c21bf8e02609924367fbdecc3fe32554c5.png[/img]
Hello, everyone!

We're so thrilled to announce that our terrifying upcoming title, [b][i]The 9th Charnel[/i][/b], will be featured at [b]The Horror Game Awards 2024[/b] on [b]Saturday, December 14th[/b]. Join us at this event and celebrate the best horror games of the year and the most highly anticipated titles in the genre. 

[i]The 9th Charnel[/i] offers a psychological survival experience where players unravel a terrifying mystery through the perspectives of six different characters. Set in an atmospheric world filled with dread and uncertainty, players must use their wits to manage resources and evade dangers by relying on weapons or stealth. 

This weekend, you will finally get a closer look at the dark, twisted world of this title as The Horror Game Awards 2024 is set to showcase a new trailer for The 9th Charnel. Don't miss out—tune in to [url=https://www.youtube.com/@HorrorGameAwards]The Horror Game Awards' official YouTube channel[/url] to witness this spine-chilling reveal. 

[b][h2]WISHLIST NOW[/h2][/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2005690/The_9th_Charnel/

notes.title: The 9th Charnel Playtesting Closed!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

I would like to extend my gratitude for your participation in playtesting the chapter “The Devil’s House” from the upcoming game The 9th Charnel. Your valuable feedback helped me a lot in making the game better. I have gathered all the feedback, made changes and now the game is ready for the next step of development.
I am excited to announce that the game is currently under active development, and am working hard to bring you the full version of the game. I appreciate your patience and support while we work to create an immersive and enjoyable experience for you.

Thank you for your time and support. I hope you will enjoy the final version of the game when it is released.
If you have any more feedback or suggestions, please feel free to reach out to me. We value your input and it helps us make the game better.

Thank you again for your support.

Best Regards,
Saikat Deb

notes.title: The 9th Charnel Playtesting is now Live!
notes.notes:
[b]The 9th Charnel Playtest[/b] is now LIVE! Playtest the chapter [b]"The Devil's House"[/b] from the game. Test the game today and give us your valuable feedback, which will definitely help us improve it.

Click on the [b]Request Access[/b] button to gain access to the playtest. Use the feedback form in the game to send us your feedback.

This is an early build of the game, so you might encounter some bugs or glitches. If you happen to face any, please let us know. Since I am a solo developer, your feedback is much appreciated and serves as a guide for improving the game.
